text: Migration committed as f5f6dd9 + 1824c35 on migrate/fmri-frame and opened as https://github.com/bbuchsbaum/fmrireg/pull/223. Gates against the DESCRIPTION-pinned companions in an isolated library: devtools::test() 0 failures / 0 errors / 3458 pass / 2 skips; R CMD build exit 0 (vignettes built, the step whose install previously failed); R CMD INSTALL into a clean library exit 0, so the as.matrix_dataset lazy-load error is gone. Two defects fixed beyond the port: (1) all matrix-backed constructors passed the caller's dimnames into fmri_frame(), which rejects them as a second unchecked naming of generated axes, so prcomp output and neuroim2::series() results failed; constructors now adopt usable column names as IDs and drop the rest. (2) estimate_hrf() derived voxel names from colnames() of the collected matrix instead of the frame's feature axis, which broke the ordering-invariance contract; it reads feature_ids() now. Also updated the validate-readme gate, which asserted the README calls matrix_dataset().
